title: Citizen Confirmation Undertaking (Notarized)
description: Sworn statement confirming the citizenship of an applicant (NADRA RP.6.0.1-B).
notes: This is a sworn statement. Read it fully, then sign it in front of a notary. The app only fills in the blanks.
Clause d (a relative who is not available) is for fresh registration only. Skip it if it does not apply.
leaveBlank: The deponent's signature, thumb impression and date
The stamp and signature of the Notary Public
